domain_restrictions: n is a positive natural number (not zero)
the functions involved are defined at the argument 0
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every positive natural number n and every integer j, the value of H with indices n and j evaluated at 0 equals the value of F with index n evaluated at the value of J with indices n and j evaluated at 0.
quantifier_order: for all n in positive natural numbers

variables.name: n
variables.role: index of functions H and F; also index of J

variables.name: j
variables.role: index of functions H and J

statement_nl: For every positive natural number n and every integer j, H_{n,j}(0) = F_n(J_{n,j}(0)).
